bio.text: Daniel Webster is a member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Florida and serves on the Transportation and Infrastructure, Natural Resources, and Science, Space and Technology committees.
Before Congress he was Speaker of the Florida House of Representatives and Majority Leader in the Florida Senate.
He was born in Charleston, West Virginia, in 1949, and earned an electrical engineering degree from Georgia Tech in 1971.
